instruction.text: Read and listen to the text.

atoms.text: Joelle plays football every day after school. Usually there are only other boys that play, and she is chosen last for the team. When Joelle is chosen last, she feels bad. She still comes back every day and knows that one day, when she is even better, she will be chosen first!
